justification: A shows a narrative hunting scene in shallow relief with a chariot, harnessed horses, an archer and lions in profile arranged as a frieze, while B is a monolithic frontal anthropomorphic figure with a blocky head and schematic body markings including a disc on the chest. Beyond the very generic presence of a human form and a circular motif in relief, there is no shared iconography, no comparable relationships between figures, and no comparable compositional scheme (frieze narrative in profile versus a single frontal statue).
